marks.gloss_en: שבשעה ש... נטל שני כוכבים מעיש וסתמה -- Ayish's two stars were taken to stop the flood, so she follows Kima demanding them
and that she (Ayish) goes after her (Kima) -- she is saying to her: give me my children
ולהדר לה? -- let Him return [Kima's own stars] to her, rather than take two from Ayish
אין הבור מתמלא מחוליתו -- a pit is not filled from its own earth
אי נמי: אין קטיגור נעשה סניגור -- alternatively: an accuser does not become a defender
וליברי לה תרי כוכבי אחריני! -- let Him create two other stars for her
אין כל חדש תחת השמש -- 'there is nothing new under the sun' (Eccl 1:9)
Rav Nachman: the Holy One will in the future return them to her
Rav Pappa to Abaye: הא אמרי אינשי -- but people say, when the doors open [to] rain, donkey-driver, fold your sack and sleep
לא קשיא: הא דקטר בעיבא, הא דקטר בענני -- no difficulty: this where [the sky] is covered with thick cloud, that where it is covered with [light] clouds
R' Shmuel bar Yitzchak: these morning clouds have no substance in them
what difference does it make [that they are harmful]? to ask for mercy
thunder was created only to straighten the crookedness of the heart
what is 'lightning'? Rava: a flash
אטו כל הני דאמרן עד השתא לאו מעשה בראשית נינהו? והכתיב ברקים למטר עשה! -- are all those we have mentioned until now not works of creation? but it is written 'He made lightnings for the rain'
כרוך ותני -- combine [the mishnah's clauses] and teach (= p_keruch_utni)

התם מברך תרתי... הכא עושה מעשה בראשית איכא, שכחו מלא עולם ליכא -- there one blesses both; here 'who makes the work of creation' but not 'whose strength fills the world' (= p_hatam_oseh_bereshit, p_oseh_bereshit, deny p_harim_shekocho)
but it is written: 'He made lightnings for the rain' (Ps 135:7)
אי הכי, גוהא גוהא מיבעי ליה -- two tears would make two earthquakes, and there was one
ולא היא: גוהא גוהא עביד, והאי דלא אודי ליה כי היכי דלא ליטעי כולי עלמא אבתריה (= p_guha_guha_aveid, p_lo_odi_lo_litei)
Rav Ketina: the necromancer is a liar and his words are lies

the necromancer: when the Holy One remembers His children in distress among the nations, He drops two tears into the Great Sea, and its sound is heard from one end of the world to the other -- and that is the earthquake
Rav Ketina's own [account]: He claps His hands
שנאמר אלביש שמים קדרות ושק אשים כסותם -- the heavens are clothed in blackness
Rav Chisda: since the day the Temple was destroyed the sky has not been seen in its purity
R' Yehoshua ben Levi: one who sees the sky in its purity says 'Blessed... Who makes creation'
ומסתברא כרב אחא בר יעקב, דבריק ברקא ומנהמי ענני ואתי מיטרא -- the lightning comes first, then the rumbling, then the rain
what is thunder? Shmuel: clouds in the sphere
והא קא חזינן דהוי! -- but we see that there are [gales at night]
ההוא דאתחיל ביממא -- that one [seen at night] began by day
והא קא חזינן דקאי! -- but we see that it does last [two hours]
דמפסיק ביני ביני -- it stops in between
what are 'winds'? Abaye: a gale
